rubricName: Architectural Alignment — StreamPlex (Upgrade to Premium button)

evalCriteria.metric: Frontend only, no new network calls
evalCriteria.prompt: The diff contains no change under `src/backend/`, and no added `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, axios or other request call in the button/modal code path. Score 0 on any such change.

The modal component does not call `useAuth`, `fetch` or router hooks, and does not hold the open/closed state itself; Billing.jsx owns that state. Score 0 if the modal reads auth/API data or manages its own visibility.
The button element appears only inside the branch rendered when billing data exists and `has_plan !== false`, never in the loading or "No active plan" branches. Score 0 otherwise.

The modal root has `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"` and an accessible name from its heading; code moves focus into it on open, restores focus to the trigger on close, and handles Escape. Score 0 if any of these is missing.

evalCriteria.metric: Reuse existing styling, no new dependencies
evalCriteria.prompt: The button uses the `btn` class from App.css, and `src/frontend/package.json` dependencies/devDependencies are unchanged. Score 0 if a new package is added or the button bypasses `.btn` for a different primary style.
